feature: regression coverage for driver search summary

focusedTest.name: WpfExperienceTests.DriverSearchSummaryDistinguishesCompleteEmptyResultsFromPartialResultsAndUnknownSource
assertions: complete search with zero candidates is labeled complete
partial search with candidates is labeled incomplete

portablePackage.portableExeSmoke: main window opened, remained responsive, and closed cleanly

scope: The test uses synthetic search results. It does not query Windows Update, download or install drivers, or change Windows settings.
